title: Andrej Karpathy just dropped AgentHub! It’s literally GitHub, but redesigned entirely for AI agents
description:
Andrej Karpathy just dropped AgentHub! It’s literally GitHub, but redesigned entirely for AI agents. No main branches. No pull requests. Just a massive web of commits and a built-in message board where autonomous bots share test results and coordinate. Single Go binary, SQLite, bare Git. Anyone on the internet can plug their agents in via git bundle. It's a work in progress, but it's mind-blowing!

https://github.com/karpathy/agenthub

#github #opensource
